# v0.5.2b1 — App protection and reliability fixes

Beta release for the integration and optional Modbus service. **0.5.1 remains
the stable release.**

- Add AppArmor protection to the app and reduce its connection selection to
  three readable USB/LAN choices.
- Fix stale queued charging-current values returning after a lost reply or
  cancellation, including across service restarts.
- Improve automatic heartbeat recovery and keep confirmed Repairs visible
  during temporary register-read failures.
- Verify the physical wallbox identity after reconnects and before control
  writes, including recovery; handle serial reconnect timing safely.
- Handle malformed device text and invalid service responses without retaining
  misleading availability. Update setup, upgrade and troubleshooting guidance.

## Update

If the app still uses `serial`, `rtu_over_tcp` or `modbus_tcp`, first save its
matching readable choice in **0.5.1**: **USB / RS-485**, **LAN: Modbus RTU (TCP)**
or **LAN: Modbus TCP**. Keep the remaining options unchanged.

Update the app from **`#apps-beta`**, then select **0.5.2b1** through the
integration's HACS/Marketplace prerelease channel and restart Home Assistant
Core. Keep the existing app data and integration entry. The app update briefly
interrupts heartbeat; a Core restart leaves the running service active.
Stable-channel app installations are not offered this beta automatically;
see the [beta update guide](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.5.2b1/docs/upgrading.md).

The integration still accepts service **0.5.0 or newer with API 2**. Updating
the app is needed for this release's service-side fixes and AppArmor profile.
